    local temp_dir
    temp_dir=$(mktemp -d)
    local counter=0

    while true; do
        local file_name="${temp_dir}/file_${counter}"

    done
}

function create_and_delete_files() {
    local temp_dir
    temp_dir=$(mktemp -d)
    trap "rm -rf $temp_dir" EXIT

    for i in {1..8}; do
        local file_name="$temp_dir/file_$i"
        touch "$file_name"
        echo "Created $file_name"
    done

    for i in {1..8}; do
        local file_name="$temp_dir/file_$i"
        if [ -e "$file_name" ]; then
            rm "$file_name"
            echo "Deleted $file_name"
        fi
    done
}

create_and_delete_files

    function contrast() {
        local fd_list=()
        local file="/tmp/contrast_file"
        touch "$file" || exit 1

        for i in {1..12}; do
            exec {fd}> "$file"
            fd_list+=("$fd")
            echo "Opened FD $fd"
        done

        for fd in "${fd_list[@]}"; do
            echo "Closing FD $fd"
            exec {fd}>&-
        done

        rm "$file"
    }

    contrast
'

                    break
                fi
            done
        }

    '

commands.text:
$(

  # Создаем временный файл для dup2
  temp_file=$(mktemp)
  echo "Initial content" > "$temp_file"

  # Получаем файловый дескриптор временного файла
  original_fd=$(ls -l "$temp_file" | awk '{print $10}' | cut -d'=' -f2 | cut -d',' -f1)

  # Закрываем стандартный вывод
  exec 1>/dev/null

  # Запоминаем текущий файловый дескриптор stdout
  original_stdout_fd=$(ls -l /proc/self/fd/1 | awk '{print $9}' | cut -d'=' -f2 | cut -d',' -f1)

  # Заменяем stdout на файловый дескриптор временного файла
  exec 1>&"$original_fd"

  # Проверяем, что stdout теперь указывает на временный файл
  new_stdout_fd=$(ls -l /proc/self/fd/1 | awk '{print $9}' | cut -d'=' -f2 | cut -d',' -f1)
  if [ "$new_stdout_fd" -ne "$original_fd" ]; then
    echo "dup2 failed"
    exit 1
  fi

  # Закрываем оригинальный файловый дескриптор stdout
  exec 1>&"$original_stdout_fd"

  # Удаляем временный файл
  rm -f "$temp_file"

)

        # Создаем новый дескриптор
        new_fd=$(exec {new_fd}<> "$temp_file")
        echo "New FD: $new_fd"

        # Проверяем, что новый дескриптор открыт
        if ! ls -l /proc/self/fd | grep "$new_fd" > /dev/null; then
            echo "Error: New FD is not open"
            exit 1
        fi

        # Закрываем новый дескриптор
        exec {new_fd}>&-

        # Проверяем, что новый дескриптор закрыт
        if ls -l /proc/self/fd | grep "$new_fd" > /dev/null; then
            echo "Error: New FD is still open"
            exit 1
        fi

        # Удаляем временный файл
        rm "$temp_file"

        echo "Cleanup complete"
    '

commands.name: bash
commands.text:
bash -c '
    function base {
        local max_iterations=8
        local iteration=0

        while [ $iteration -lt $max_iterations ]; do
            local pipe
            pipe=$(mkfifo /tmp/pipe.$iteration)
            if [ $? -ne 0 ]; then
                echo "Failed to create pipe"
                exit 1
            fi

            local fd
            exec {fd}<>/tmp/pipe.$iteration
            if [ $? -ne 0 ]; then
                echo "Failed to open pipe"
                rm -f /tmp/pipe.$iteration
                exit 1
            fi

            # Close one end of the pipe
            exec {fd}<&-
            if [ $? -ne 0 ]; then
                echo "Failed to close one end of the pipe"
                rm -f /tmp/pipe.$iteration
                exit 1
            fi

            # Cleanup the pipe file
            rm -f /tmp/pipe.$iteration
            if [ $? -ne 0 ]; then
                echo "Failed to remove pipe file"
                exit 1
            fi

            iteration=$((iteration + 1))
        done
    }

    base
'

commands.text:
$(

    # Создаем временный файл
    temp_file=$(mktemp)
    echo "Temporary file created: $temp_file"

    # Открываем файл и получаем его FD
    exec {fd}> "$temp_file"
    echo "File descriptor opened: $fd"

    # Функция для обработки ошибок
    handle_error() {
        echo "Error occurred, closing FD $fd"
        exec {fd}>&-
    }

    # Основной цикл с ограничением на 8 повторений
    for i in {1..8}; do
        echo "Iteration $i"
        # Намеренно возбуждаем локальную ошибку
        if (( i % 2 == 0 )); then
            echo "Simulating error on iteration $i"
            handle_error
            continue
        fi

        # Пишем в файл
        echo "Data written to file on iteration $i" >&$fd
    done

    # Закрываем FD в finally-подобной секции
    exec {fd}>&-
    echo "FD $fd closed"

    # Удаляем временный файл
    rm "$temp_file"
    echo "Temporary file removed: $temp_file"

)

function contrast {
    local max_iterations=5
    local current_iteration=0
    local fd

    while [ $current_iteration -lt $max_iterations ]; do
        # Create a file and get its FD
        exec {fd}> /dev/null

        # Duplicate the FD
        exec {dup_fd}<> /dev/null
        dup2 $fd $dup_fd

        # Close the original FD

        local open_fds=$(ls /proc/$$/fd | wc -l)

        # Close the duplicated FD
        exec {dup_fd}>&-

        # Increment the iteration counter
        ((current_iteration++))
    done
}

        # Cleanup

        echo "Cleanup complete"

#!/bin/bash

# Проверка наличия необходимых команд
if ! command -v statvfs &> /dev/null || ! command -v df &> /dev/null; then
    echo "UNSUPPORTED: Required commands (statvfs, df) are not available."
    exit 1
fi

# Определение функции для чтения statvfs и вычисления доступных inode и байтов
read_statvfs() {
    local mount_point="$1"
    local statvfs_output
    statvfs_output=$(statvfs "$mount_point")
    local f_bfree
    local f_frsize
    local f_files
    local f_ffree

    # Извлечение значений из вывода statvfs
    f_bfree=$(echo "$statvfs_output" | awk '/^f_bfree/ {print $2}')
    f_frsize=$(echo "$statvfs_output" | awk '/^f_frsize/ {print $2}')
    f_files=$(echo "$statvfs_output" | awk '/^f_files/ {print $2}')
    f_ffree=$(echo "$statvfs_output" | awk '/^f_ffree/ {print $2}')

    # Вычисление доступных байтов
    local available_bytes=$((f_bfree * f_frsize))

    # Вывод результатов
    echo "Available inodes: $f_ffree"
    echo "Available bytes: $available_bytes"
}

# Определение функции для создания трёх пустых фикстур
create_fixtures() {
    local mount_point="$1"
    local fixture1="$mount_point/fixture1"
    local fixture2="$mount_point/fixture2"
    local fixture3="$mount_point/fixture3"

    # Создание фикстур
    touch "$fixture1" "$fixture2" "$fixture3"

    # Проверка успешности создания фикстур
    if [ ! -f "$fixture1" ] || [ ! -f "$fixture2" ] || [ ! -f "$fixture3" ]; then
        echo "Error: Failed to create fixtures."
        exit 1
    fi
}

# Определение функции для уборки фикстур
cleanup_fixtures() {
    local mount_point="$1"
    local fixture1="$mount_point/fixture1"
    local fixture2="$mount_point/fixture2"
    local fixture3="$mount_point/fixture3"

    # Удаление фикстур
    rm -f "$fixture1" "$fixture2" "$fixture3"

    # Проверка успешности удаления фикстур
    if [ -f "$fixture1" ] || [ -f "$fixture2" ] || [ -f "$fixture3" ]; then
        echo "Error: Failed to clean up fixtures."
        exit 1
    fi
}

# Основная точка входа
main() {
    local mount_point="$1"

    # Чтение statvfs и вычисление доступных inode и байтов
    read_statvfs "$mount_point"

    # Создание трёх пустых фикстур
    create_fixtures "$mount_point"

    # Проверка обеих границ (inode и bytes)
    # Здесь можно добавить дополнительные проверки, если необходимо

    # Уборка фикстур
    cleanup_fixtures "$mount_point"
}

# Запуск основной точки входа с передачей аргументов
main "$@"

function check_limits() {
    local mount_point="/tmp"
    local temp_dir
    temp_dir=$(mktemp -d "${mount_point}/test.XXXXXX")
    if [ $? -ne 0 ]; then
        echo "Failed to create temporary directory"
        exit 1
    fi

    local statvfs_output
    statvfs_output=$(statvfs -c "f_blocks=%b f_bfree=%f f_files=%c f_ffree=%f" "${mount_point}")
    if [ $? -ne 0 ]; then
        echo "Failed to get statvfs output"
        rm -rf "${temp_dir}"
        exit 1
    fi

    local total_blocks total_free_blocks total_files total_free_files
    total_blocks=$(echo "${statvfs_output}" | awk -F= '{print $2}')
    total_free_blocks=$(echo "${statvfs_output}" | awk -F= '{print $4}')
    total_files=$(echo "${statvfs_output}" | awk -F= '{print $6}')
    total_free_files=$(echo "${statvfs_output}" | awk -F= '{print $8}')

    local inode_limit=$((total_files / 2))
    local bytes_limit=$((total_blocks * 512 / 2))

    local inode_usage=0
    local bytes_usage=0

    for i in {1..3}; do
        local file_path="${temp_dir}/file${i}"
        touch "${file_path}"
        if [ $? -ne 0 ]; then
            echo "Failed to create file ${file_path}"
            rm -rf "${temp_dir}"
            exit 1
        fi

        local file_stat
        file_stat=$(stat -c "size=%s" "${file_path}")
        if [ $? -ne 0 ]; then
            echo "Failed to get file stat for ${file_path}"
            rm -rf "${temp_dir}"
            exit 1
        fi

        local file_size
        file_size=$(echo "${file_stat}" | awk -F= '{print $2}')
        bytes_usage=$((bytes_usage + file_size))
        inode_usage=$((inode_usage + 1))

        if [ "${inode_usage}" -ge "${inode_limit}" ] || [ "${bytes_usage}" -ge "${bytes_limit}" ]; then
            echo "Reached limit: inode=${inode_usage}, bytes=${bytes_usage}"
            rm -rf "${temp_dir}"
            exit 0
        fi
    done

    echo "No limits reached: inode=${inode_usage}, bytes=${bytes_usage}"
    rm -rf "${temp_dir}"
    exit 0
}

check_limits
'

# Функция для чтения statvfs и вычисления доступных inode и байтов
read_statvfs() {
    local mount_point="$1"

    echo "Available inodes: $available_inodes"

}

create_fixtures() {
    local mount_point="$1"
    local fixture1="$mount_point/fixture1"
    local fixture2="$mount_point/fixture2"
    local fixture3="$mount_point/fixture3"
    touch "$fixture1" "$fixture2" "$fixture3"
    echo "Fixtures created: $fixture1, $fixture2, $fixture3"
}

# Функция для очистки фикстур
cleanup_fixtures() {
    local mount_point="$1"
    local fixture1="$mount_point/fixture1"
    local fixture2="$mount_point/fixture2"
    local fixture3="$mount_point/fixture3"
    rm -f "$fixture1" "$fixture2" "$fixture3"
    echo "Fixtures cleaned up"
}

main() {
    local mount_point="$1"
    local max_inodes="$2"
    local max_bytes="$3"

    # Создание фикстур
    create_fixtures "$mount_point"

    # Проверка границ

bash -c '
function create_files() {
    local dir
    dir=$(mktemp -d)
    echo "Base: Created directory $dir"

    local budget=50000
    local used_inodes=0
    local used_metadata=0

    for ((i=0; i<20000; i++)); do
        local file="$dir/file$i"
        touch "$file"
        used_inodes=$((used_inodes + 1))
        used_metadata=$((used_metadata + 1024))  # Assuming each file uses 1 KiB of metadata

        if (( used_inodes >= budget )); then
            echo "Base: Budget exceeded with $used_inodes inodes and $used_metadata metadata"
            break
        fi
    done

    echo "Base: Created $used_inodes files in $dir"
    echo "Base: Cleanup: Removing directory $dir"
    rm -rf "$dir"
}

create_files
'

    create_temp_files() {

        local files=()

            files+=("$(mktemp)")
        done
        echo "${files[@]}"
    }

    # Функция для закрытия файлов

        local files=("$@")
        for file in "${files[@]}"; do
            rm -f "$file"
        done
    }

    main() {
        local files=()
        trap "close_files \"\${files[@]}\"" EXIT

        # Создание четырёх файлов
        files=($(create_temp_files 4))

        # Использование файлов (например, вывод их имен)
        echo "Opened files: ${files[@]}"

        # Ожидание завершения

commands.name: bash
commands.text:
bash -c '
function create_files {
    local temp_dir=$(mktemp -d)
    local inode_limit=50000
    local file_count=20000

    # Check if the temporary directory was created successfully
    if [ ! -d "$temp_dir" ]; then
        echo "Failed to create temporary directory"
        return 1
    fi

    # Create files in the temporary directory
    for ((i=0; i<file_count; i++)); do
        touch "$temp_dir/file$i"
    done

    # Check the number of inodes used
    local inode_usage=$(df -i "$temp_dir" | awk '\''NR==2 {print $3}'\'')

    if [ "$inode_usage" -gt "$inode_limit" ]; then
        echo "Inode usage exceeded the limit"
        return 1
    fi

    echo "Files created in $temp_dir"
}

create_files
'

    temp_dir=$(mktemp -d)
    echo "Temporary directory created: $temp_dir"

    local file_count=20000
    for ((i=0; i<file_count; i++)); do
        touch "$temp_dir/file_$i"
    done
    echo "Created $file_count files in $temp_dir"

    # Cleanup
    rm -rf "$temp_dir"
    echo "Temporary directory and files cleaned up"
}

    # Создаем временный каталог для изоляции
    temp_dir=$(mktemp -d)
    trap "rm -rf $temp_dir" EXIT

    # Запускаем первый Python-процесс с ограниченным FD
    (
        ulimit -n 5
        python3 -c "import os; [os.open(f'{temp_dir}/file{i}', os.O_CREAT) for i in range(5)]"

    # Проверяем количество открытых FD в текущем процессе
    echo "Open FDs in current process: $(ls /proc/$$/fd | wc -l)"
'

commands.name: bash
commands.text:
bash -c '
        # Create a temporary directory for isolation
        temp_dir=$(mktemp -d)
        if [ $? -ne 0 ]; then
            echo "Failed to create temporary directory"
            exit 1
        fi

        # Function to clean up resources
        cleanup() {
            rm -rf "$temp_dir"
            echo "Cleanup completed"
        }

        # Set a trap for cleanup on exit
        trap cleanup EXIT

        # First Python process with FD limit
        python3 -c "import os; import resource; resource.setrlimit(resource.RLIMIT_NOFILE, (10, 10)); open_files = [open(f'{temp_dir}/file{i}', 'w') for i in range(10)]; input('Press Enter to continue...')" &

        # Wait for the first process to finish
        wait $!

        # Second Python process with a small set of FDs and explicit closure
        python3 -c "import os; import resource; open_files = [open(f'{temp_dir}/file{i}', 'w') for i in range(5)]; for f in open_files: f.close(); input('Press Enter to continue...')" &

        # Wait for the second process to finish
        wait $!

        # Check the number of open file descriptors
        open_fds=$(ls -l /proc/self/fd | wc -l)
        echo "Number of open file descriptors: $open_fds"

        # Verify that the FD limit is not inherited
        current_limit=$(ulimit -n)
        echo "Current FD limit: $current_limit"
    '

commands.text:
bash -c '(
  # Создаем временный файл
  temp_file=$(mktemp)
  echo "Temporary file created: $temp_file"

  # Запоминаем текущее количество открытых файловых дескрипторов
  initial_fd_count=$(ls /proc/self/fd | wc -l)
  echo "Initial FD count: $initial_fd_count"

  # Открываем временный файл
  exec 3>"$temp_file"
  echo "File descriptor 3 opened for writing to $temp_file"

  # Снимаем снимок FD после открытия файла
  current_fd_count=$(ls /proc/self/fd | wc -l)
  echo "Current FD count after opening file: $current_fd_count"

  # Закрываем временный файл
  exec 3>&-
  echo "File descriptor 3 closed"

  # Снимаем снимок FD после закрытия файла
  final_fd_count=$(ls /proc/self/fd | wc -l)
  echo "Final FD count after closing file: $final_fd_count"

  # Удаляем временный файл
  rm "$temp_file"
  echo "Temporary file removed"

  # Проверяем, что количество FD вернулось к исходному
  if [ "$final_fd_count" -eq "$initial_fd_count" ]; then
    echo "FD count restored successfully"
  else
    echo "FD count not restored"
  fi
)'

function limited_context_manager() {
    local temp_files=()
    local exit_stack=()

    # Create three TemporaryFiles
    for i in {1..3}; do
        local temp_file=$(mktemp)
        temp_files+=("$temp_file")
        exit_stack+=("$temp_file")
    done

    # Simulate some actions
    echo "Performing actions with temporary files..."
    for file in "${temp_files[@]}"; do
        echo "Using file: $file"
    done

    # Explicitly exit the context
    for file in "${exit_stack[@]}"; do
        rm -f "$file"
    done
    echo "Context exited, temporary files cleaned up."
}

# Call the function
limited_context_manager
'

# Create an ExitStack context manager
with ExitStack() as stack:
    # Create three temporary files
    temp_files = [stack.enter_context(tempfile.TemporaryFile()) for _ in range(3)]

    # Print the names and inodes of the temporary files
    for tf in temp_files:
        print(f"Name: {tf.name}, Inode: {tf.fileno()}")

    # Explicitly exit the context
    stack.close()

    # Print a message indicating the context has been exited
    print("Context has been exited")
